description:
Identifiers for a withdrawn Dependabot alert, captured before deletion so that
consumers can reconcile external records. This is not a full alert representation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the withdrawn alert.

node_id.description: The GraphQL node ID of the withdrawn alert.

state.description: The state of the Dependabot alert.

ecosystem.description: The package's language or package management ecosystem.

name.description: The unique package name within its ecosystem.

manifest_path.description: The full path to the dependency manifest file, relative to the root of the repository.

version_requirement.description:
The dependency version or version constraint last recorded for the dependency associated with this alert.
For dependencies detected from a lockfile, this can be the resolved version.
For manifest-only dependencies, it can be the declared version constraint. Returns `null` when unavailable.

An empty string can indicate an unconstrained dependency. The stored value is limited to 64 bytes;
longer requirements may have been truncated and may no longer form a complete, valid version constraint.

When multiple vulnerable versions of a dependency correspond to the same alert, this field contains one
recorded version or constraint and may not represent all vulnerable versions.

scope.description: The execution scope of the vulnerable dependency.

relationship.description:
The vulnerable dependency's relationship to your project.

> [!NOTE]
> We are rolling out support for dependency relationship across ecosystems. This value will be "unknown" for all dependencies in unsupported ecosystems.

security_advisory.description: Identifiers of the advisory that produced the withdrawn alert.

ghsa_id.description: The unique GitHub identifier assigned to the advisory.

cve_id.description: The CVE identifier assigned to the advisory, if any.

url.description: The REST API URL of the alert resource.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL of the alert resource.

created_at.description: The time that the alert was created in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

withdrawn_at.description: The time that the alert was withdrawn in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. This is not the advisory's withdrawal time.
